verdict.rationale: The only first-party event-to-action evidence is narrow: budgets with notifications can drive programmatic cost-control responses through Pub/Sub, and Personalized Service Health offers custom incident alerts. Nothing in the pack documents a general-purpose rules engine for triggering actions on arbitrary cloud events. Missing for 10: a general event-routing or trigger capability across services, documentation of rule definition and action configuration beyond billing budgets, complete (untruncated) docs on the Pub/Sub budget response, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
